steps: Set up a sturdy ladder on level ground with a stabilizer.
Scoop out leaves and debris by hand or gutter scoop, working toward the downspout.
Flush the gutter with a hose to check the slope and flow.
Run water down each downspout to confirm it isn't clogged.
Check for sagging sections or loose hangers while you're up there.
videoTitle: How to Clear Your Home's Gutters in a Few Simple Steps - This Old House
